independenceStatement: Read the supplied candidate and bilingual rubric, both texts of each of the twenty submissions, and every submitted drawing from the blind packet. Viewed R01, R02, R03, R04, R05, R06 and R08 individually. No repository, author expectations, prior version, other marks or reconciliation consulted. These are synthetic submissions.
findings: Physics and numerical solution: The stated reference frame, scales, carrier, 6 m/s rightward, length change from 3 cm to 2 cm, and final gap of one drawn centimetre are correct. The tail locates A in the snapshot. The head supplies no further position or contact information. A future position requires a time interval and a motion assumption.

Elicitation: The candidate supplies no learner-facing sketch I. The stem gives the origin, direction, arrow label, length and apparent coincidence in words. A learner can reproduce these facts without interpreting an existing diagram. Supply sketch I with a visible arrow, a position scale and an independent velocity scale, and remove the read-offs from the stem. A labelled ruler or grid with an invariant scale lets learners measure it at any zoom. Deliberate coincidence is appropriate as the misconception being examined.

Material score ambiguity: D(i) admits equivalent working, and the shared rule admits evidence in the actual drawing. R01 plus the 6/3 calculation explicitly constructs the tip at tick 2 and B at tick 3. I credited this geometrical prediction in S05 and S20, even though there is no separate prose prediction. A marker requiring an explicit comparison could instead assign S05 D=0 (9/fail) and S20 D=1 (10/pass). The current text leaves the meaning of equivalent working underdetermined at the pass boundary.

Validity of the total: 3 points per performance with a 10/12 pass protects against losing an entire performance; with a zero in any criterion the maximum is 9. It does not guarantee that the learner explains why the tip gives no contact/place: S03 and, on the graphic-evidence reading, S05 pass with that entire semantic interpretation omitted. In D, reserve the initial point for a meaningful interpretation of the tip (e.g. changing scale changes the tip while bodies stay put, so tip coincidence establishes no contact or position), and give further points for elaboration within D. Define what an annotated sketch can establish. This retains the total-only decision without an additional pass condition.

Partial robustness: S04 fails by half a point, S02/S14/S15/S16 retain the small-slip allowance, S06 through S11 fail through the appropriate individual criterion, and the retraction in S12 restores full credit. Correctly reasoned text-only S13 earns 6.5. C(iii) requires labels in actual drawings. If the intended policy is to credit position/velocity legends in prose even without a drawing, C(iii) must state that explicitly.

Follow-through: S14 states 2.5 cm in the calculation and drawing, then uses 2 cm in the reason for the correct geometric prediction. S19 draws and asserts 3 cm but also gives the correct 2-versus-3 comparison separately. I credited the physically correct explicit D reasoning independently of C. If consistent follow-through itself is meant to be exercised by these probes, make the comparison in the response use its own wrong length. S17 similarly refers in prose to the specified sketch while drawing translated arrows; did not deduct that origin error a second time.

Language and feasibility: DE and EN support the same decisions. Integer multiplication/division, a named ground frame and scaled drawing are suitable for lower-secondary learners who have met the two units. Paper photo or an uploaded digital sketch can supply the demanded evidence in a coach chat capable of passing images to the marker; this is a content feasibility judgement. Runtime attachment transmission was outside the packet. Direction relative to the unique given frame can be expressed simply as rightward; restating ground need not be treated as a separate vocabulary hurdle.

Scope: This task samples velocity in one dimension at one instant and transfer to a new numerical scale. It does not independently establish competence with forces, fields or vector addition. The single covered goal ID is distinct from the assessment ID; the physics verdict applies to the performance claimed in the candidate description. No provider, view or jurisdiction fidelity was assessed.

de.rationale: R01 zeigt beide Ansätze, Richtungen, Längen und Legenden. Rechnung, Scheinberührung und Invarianz sind ausdrücklich erklärt.

en.rationale: R01 supplies both origins, directions, lengths and legends. The calculations, apparent contact and physical invariance are explained.

de.rationale: Der abschließend angegebene Wert trägt m. Rechnung, zwei Pfeillegenden in R01 und die Erklärung zeigen m/s als verstandene Einheit. Ein lokaler Fehler in C.

en.rationale: The final reported value carries m. The computation, both R01 velocity legends and the explanation establish understanding of m/s. One local slip in C.

de.rationale: Die ausdrückliche Voraussage und die Rechnung mit der bemaßten R01 begründen, dass die Spitze vor B bleibt. Eine Deutung von Kontakt/Ort und die ausdrückliche Invarianz fehlen.

en.rationale: The explicit noncoincidence prediction, rescaling calculation and dimensioned R01 establish the new tip short of B. Contact/position interpretation and explicit invariance are missing.

de.rationale: R01 stützt die Voraussage mit 2 statt 3 cm. Die Bedeutung und Invarianz fehlen; die falsche Einheit am Ergebnis kostet unabhängig 0,5 in C.

en.rationale: R01 supports the prediction with 2 versus 3 cm. Interpretation and invariance are missing. The wrong unit on the final value independently costs half a point in C.

de.rationale: 6/3 = 2 cm und R01 mit Spitze auf Strich 2 und B auf Strich 3 stellen den geometrischen Vergleich sichtbar dar. Keine Deutung von Kontakt/Ort oder ausdrücklich erklärter physikalischer Invarianz. Alternative Lesart des Rasters siehe Befund.

en.rationale: The 6/3 = 2 cm calculation and R01 marking the tip at tick 2 and B at 3 give a visible geometric comparison. No physical explanation of contact/position or explicit invariance is given. See scoring ambiguity.

de.rationale: Die abschließende Behauptung ordnet den Pfeil wegen seiner Spitze ausdrücklich B zu. A entfällt, übrige Leistungen einschließlich R01 belegt.

en.rationale: The maintained conclusion assigns the arrow to B on account of its tip. A is zero. R01 and prose support the other performances.

de.rationale: Ein beliebiger Ansatz wird ausdrücklich verteidigt. Die korrekt angesetzten Pfeile in R01 lösen den Widerspruch nicht auf.

en.rationale: The learner maintains that the origin is arbitrary. Correctly drawn origins in R01 do not resolve this contradiction.

de.rationale: Die Antwort hält daran fest, dass der Rechtspfeil Bewegung nach links bedeute. Das entwertet B trotz der beiden Rechtspfeile in R01.

en.rationale: The learner maintains that a rightward arrow signifies motion left. B is zero despite both rightward arrows in R01.

de.rationale: Die ausdrückliche Gleichsetzung von 6 m/s und 6 m entwertet C trotz richtiger Skalen und Rechnung. D wird durch die getrennte Erklärung der Spitze belegt.

en.rationale: The maintained equivalence of 6 m/s and 6 m sets C to zero despite the legends and calculation. The separate explanation of the tip supports D.

de.rationale: Die ausdrückliche und aufrechterhaltene Behauptung einer Berührung betrifft D. Die korrekte Zeichnung bleibt für A bis C belastbar.

en.rationale: The maintained claim of actual contact is a D misconception. The drawing and calculation substantiate A through C.

de.rationale: Der Skalenwechsel soll nach ausdrücklicher Überzeugung die wirkliche Geschwindigkeit ändern. D entfällt.

en.rationale: The learner maintains that the scale change alters the actual velocity. D is zero.

de.rationale: Die erste Vermutung zur Berührung wird ausdrücklich zurückgenommen und durch die korrekte Deutung ersetzt. R01 und Rechnung sind vollständig.

en.rationale: The initial contact interpretation is explicitly retracted and replaced by the scale explanation. R01 and the computation supply the other evidence.

de.rationale: Nur Text: Zuordnung, Richtung, Betragsrechnung, halber Punkt für neue Länge und alle drei Deutungen. Tatsächliche Pfeile und Legenden in Zeichnungen fehlen.

en.rationale: Prose supplies assignment, direction, magnitude working, half credit for the new length, and the three interpretations. There are no drawings or actual drawing legends.

de.rationale: Die korrekte Division ist angesetzt, aber als 2,5 ausgewertet und in R05 übernommen. Ein Rechenfehler in C. Die Spitze liegt auch dann vor B; die Antwort begründet die richtige Voraussage separat mit dem richtigen Wert 2.

en.rationale: The correct division is set up but evaluated as 2.5 and drawn that way in R05. One arithmetic slip in C. The tip remains short under either value and the answer separately reasons with the correct 2.

de.rationale: In R06 wird m in beiden v_A-Legenden wiederholt, während Rechnung und Erläuterung m und m/s ausdrücklich unterscheiden. Ein gemeinsamer Schreibfehler.

en.rationale: R06 repeats m in both v_A legends; the written calculation and explanation explicitly distinguish m from m/s. One repeated unit-writing fault.

de.rationale: Der Pfeilkopf fehlt in II in R08. Der gezeichnete Ansatz und die Länge stimmen, der erste Pfeil und die Erklärung sichern die beabsichtigte Richtung. Lokaler Zeichenfehler in B.

en.rationale: R08 lacks the second arrowhead. The drawn origin and length are correct. The first arrow and the prose confirm the intended direction. One local drawing slip in B.

de.rationale: R02 setzt beide Pfeile an B an, ausdrücklich aus der behaupteten Trägerschaft von B. Richtung, Längen und Legenden sind sachgerecht. Die schriftliche Erklärung bezieht sich korrekt auf die vorgegebene Situation.

en.rationale: R02 originates both arrows at B, consistent with the asserted wrong carrier. Direction, lengths and scales are correct. The prose separately explains the intended geometry of the given situation.

de.rationale: R03 setzt beide Pfeile bei A an, beide nach links. Die behauptete Gleichheit von links und rechts bleibt bestehen; Länge und physikalische Spitzendeutung sind unabhängig belegt.

en.rationale: R03 starts both arrows at A and points both left. The maintained equivalence of left and right removes B. Lengths and physical interpretation are independently evidenced.

de.rationale: R04 belässt 3 cm bei beiden Skalen. Die Antwort verteidigt dies als allgemeine Regel. C entfällt. Die schriftliche korrekte 2-zu-3-Begründung bewerte ich in D eigenständig trotz Widerspruch zur Zeichnung.

en.rationale: R04 keeps both lengths at 3 cm and the learner asserts unchanged arrow length as a general rule. C is zero. The explicit correct 2-versus-3 explanation earns D(i) independently, despite its conflict with the drawing.

de.rationale: R01 und Rechnung bilden den Vergleich 2 zu 3 ab. Der Text deutet das maßstabsbedingte Treffen ausdrücklich als Aussage ohne Orts-/Kontaktbeweis. Explizite Invarianz fehlt.

en.rationale: R01 and the computation show the 2-versus-3 comparison. The text links the apparent meeting to scale and rejects any position/contact inference. Explicit physical invariance is missing.

drawingObservations.R01: Both origins A and both rightward; first tip at B/3, second at tick 2. Position and speed legends correct.
drawingObservations.R02: Both origins B; rightward arrows of 3 and 2 drawn cm. Positions unchanged and legends distinguish x and v_A.
drawingObservations.R03: Both origins A; both arrowheads left, lengths 3 and 2 drawn cm. Legends correct.
drawingObservations.R04: Both origins A and both arrowheads right. In II the tip is still at B, 3 drawn cm from A despite the new legend.
drawingObservations.R05: Second rightward arrow from A ends at the 2.5 tick; first reaches B/3. Legends are appropriate.
drawingObservations.R06: Correct geometry from A, both rightward. Both v_A legends show m in place of m/s; x legends correctly show m.
drawingObservations.R08: First arrow from A rightwards to B. The blue horizontal segment from A reaches tick 2 in II but has no arrowhead. Both scales specified.
